# parlay-club

> Docs map generated by `good-vibes docs index`. Edit the docs, then regenerate this file.

## High-level

- [Architecture](../ARCHITECTURE.md): The system's parts, their boundaries, and the rules that hold across them.
- [Glossary](../GLOSSARY.md): The words this project uses, and the words to avoid.

## Concept

- [Access](concepts/access.md): How Google sign-in, open sign-up, and signed session and group cookies decide who is using the app and which group they see.
- [Analyzer](concepts/analyzer.md): How the sharp-friend analyzer turns legs, games, weather, player stats, nfelo's model, and nflverse efficiency into plain-Go warnings and calibrated four-pillar A–F grades.
- [Response archive](concepts/archive.md): How every successful external API response is kept raw in SQLite, how the source key labels it, and how to read the stored metadata and gzipped bodies.
- [Data refresh](concepts/data-refresh.md): How page loads, per-game-day pre-fill, and on-demand views sync slate, weather, odds, props, rosters, injuries, projections, and auto-grading with staleness windows, credit floors, and shutdown drain.
- [Docs hub](concepts/docs-hub.md): How the Docs tab explains grading, odds, badges, live progress, autograding, sources, and export, and how every inline `?` help bubble reaches the matching section.
- [Export](concepts/export.md): How a locked slip turns stored sportsbook deep links into a one-tap combined DraftKings or FanDuel link, with per-leg taps, a manual list, and copy text for every pick that has no link.
- [Groups](concepts/groups.md): How groups split people into shared clubs, how invites and leaving work, how recurring slip schedules automate weekly slips, and how the active group scopes what a person sees.
- [Live updates](concepts/live-updates.md): How a slip page hears about changes through one SSE stream, and how the hub, deadlines, and client reconnect keep that stream cheap.
- [Notifications](concepts/notifications.md): How the app installs to a phone or desktop home screen, turns on per-device Web Push from the profile page, stores subscriptions, and sends test messages, slip events, and timed kickoff reminders through VAPID.
- [Persistence](concepts/persistence.md): How one SQLite file holds every slip and every cached response, how Litestream restores and replicates it on Cloud Run, why only one process may write to it, and how the local sandbox keeps its own file and stage row.
- [Slips](concepts/slips.md): How a group builds and tracks shared parlays from the slate, covering slate scopes, deadlines, the hub, live progress, A-grade highlights, the pick board, votes, wagers, grading, and editing rules.

## Decision

- [Decision map](decisions/llms.txt): Listed in its own map.

## Guide

- [GCP setup](guides/gcp-setup.md): Create the Google Cloud project resources once, add the secrets and GitHub variables, and run the first deploy that puts the app on Cloud Run.
- [Local development](guides/local-dev.md): Start the app with hot reload, run the offline Sunday sandbox, set up the git hooks, run offline evals, and retrain the v2 grading model.

## Reference

- [Analyzer rules](reference/analyzer-rules.md): The stable IDs, severities, triggers, and example messages for all 16 analyzer rules, plus the v2 calibrated four-pillar grading model, Gaussian copula script scoring, extensible context overlays, and v1 rubric reference.
- [Configuration](reference/config.md): Environment variables the server reads, including dev defaults, odds and Web Push keys, the pre-fill and reminder bearer tokens, the Cloud Tasks queue, the sandbox switch, and the values it rejects in prod.
- [Data sources](reference/data-sources.md): ESPN scoreboard, rosters, game logs, and injuries, Open-Meteo weather, Parlay API and The Odds API lines, props, and credits, nfelo, nflverse, player matching, and the API archive.
- [Odds math](reference/odds-math.md): Formulas in internal/parlay for odds, implied probability, multiplicative, Power, and Shin de-vigging, price edge, fair EV, payouts, and units, plus internal/progress for live leg and parlay progress and hit probability.
- [Routes](reference/routes.md): Every HTTP route the server serves, the middleware in front of them, and the status codes, HTMX headers, and SSE frames handlers return.
- [Sandbox replay](reference/sandbox-replay.md): The fail-closed HTTP transport and named week 9 response registry behind the local Sunday sandbox, the requests they answer or leave as labeled empty fallbacks, which fixtures are real captures versus derived snapshots, and how startup, reset, stages, seeded people, and scripted grades replay them.
- [Database schema](reference/schema.md): SQLite schema, migrations, connection pools, and table conventions for groups, users, games, odds, nfelo, nflverse, slips, legs, rosters, game logs, push subscriptions, reminder tasks, and the API archive.

## Runbook

- [Archive size check](runbooks/archive-size.md): Measure the raw response archive and the SQLite file, know the number to act at, and prune old responses without losing the parsed tables.
- [Database recovery](runbooks/database-recovery.md): Recover from a corrupt Litestream replica by finding the last good transaction, seeding a fresh replica, and repointing Cloud Run without losing user data.
- [Deploy](runbooks/deploy.md): How a commit reaches Cloud Run, why deploys pause during game windows, how to force one, and how to verify, roll back, and read the spend.
- [Push setup](runbooks/push-setup.md): Generate a VAPID key pair, turn Web Push on in local dev and production, set up the Cloud Tasks reminder queue, and confirm delivery with Send test and the first-week check.
